notes.title: The game's major version update will be officially launched on April 25, 2025
notes.content:
o all dear players:
Today (April 25, 2025), we officially launched the game's major version update! Thank you all for your patience and valuable suggestions.
This update focuses on optimizing the guidance and user experience issues previously reported by players, with the following main updates:
1. Refactoring Game Guidance System - Optimizing Guidance Interaction Process
2. Remake game sound effects to enhance interaction and immersion in the scene
3. Add "Strange Stories" - including task guidance, task introduction, customs introduction, etc
4. Several new achievements have been added - enriching game challenges and collecting fun
We deeply understand that our previous shortcomings have caused a poor experience for everyone, and once again we sincerely apologize to all players. This update is the first step in our continuous optimization. In the future, we will continue to listen to players' voices and continuously improve the game.
Thank you to every player for their support and tolerance!
HHGame Studio
April 25, 2025

notes.title: We will conduct a major game version update this month (April 2025)
notes.content:
To all dear players:
Firstly, we sincerely apologize to all the players who have supported us!
Since the game was launched, we have received a large amount of feedback regarding unclear game guidance and poor user experience. Due to our inadequate testing and optimization work, many players encountered setbacks and confusion during the initial experience, which completely goes against our original intention of providing a high-quality gaming experience. We deeply apologize to all affected players.
We are making every effort to improve the game, and the team has developed a detailed optimization plan based on player feedback. The following are the core updates that will be launched this month:
1. Refactoring the game guidance system
2. Remake game sound effects
3. Add a record of strange and unusual events, including task guidance, task introduction, customs introduction, etc
4. Several new achievements have been added
class
We will conduct a major game version update this month (April 2025).
Thank you again to every player who has criticized, suggested, or even angered us - it is your voice that has made us aware of our shortcomings. We will demonstrate our sincerity through continuous actions and earnestly request everyone to give us the opportunity to improve.
HHGame Studio
April 21, 2025
